race.comment: MARGIN CALL (2) ran a better race last start to finish a close third over 1000m at Ballarat Synthetic. Looks well placed so expect another big run. Shinn's booking adds another layer of confidence. AUSTRALIAN LEGACY (9) was a determined maiden winner last time out, scoring by a head over this trip at Ballarat Synthetic. Has plenty of scope for improvement and shapes a great chance to go back-to-back. ASTARI (8) caught the eye fresh when closing strongly late into midfield then hit the line well again here last time. Peaking now and is a big chance to break through off a month in-between. DUEL VENTURE (3) is ticking along okay and deserves consideration.
